task_instance: Produce a full legal risk assessment (per SKILL.md's severity x likelihood framework and memo/risk-register templates) for a sample matter: a vendor Data Processing Agreement that lacks a data breach notification clause and permits a cross-border personal-data transfer to a sub-processor with no EU adequacy decision/SCCs. Score each issue, classify GREEN/YELLOW/ORANGE/RED, write the full risk assessment memo, and produce risk register CSV entries.
evidence: Work performed entirely with local files and python3, no network/tools needed. Files produced in the work directory: sample_matter.md (the fact pattern), risk_score.py (implements the Severity x Likelihood scoring/level logic from SKILL.md), risk_assessment_memo.md (full memo following SKILL.md's 10-section Risk Assessment Memo Format), risk_register_entries.csv (two entries following SKILL.md's Risk Register Entry field schema). Verification: ran `python3 risk_score.py`, which self-tests risk_level() against all 25 cells of the SKILL.md severity/likelihood matrix (all assertions passed, printed matrix matches SKILL.md's ASCII matrix exactly) and then computed Issue 1 = severity 4 x likelihood 3 = 12 -> ORANGE, Issue 2 = severity 4 x likelihood 4 = 16 -> RED, matching the scores written into the memo. Also parsed risk_register_entries.csv with Python's csv module and asserted programmatically that each row's Risk Score field equals Severity x Likelihood, confirming internal consistency (LR-2026-014: 12/ORANGE, LR-2026-015: 16/RED). Memo section headers were grep-checked and match all 10 required sections (Risk Description, Background and Context, Risk Analysis with Severity/Likelihood/Score subsections for each issue, Contributing Factors, Mitigating Factors, Mitigation Options table, Recommended Approach, Residual Risk, Monitoring Plan, Next Steps). The core deliverable of this skill (a structured, documented legal risk assessment with a defensible severity x likelihood score, risk level, and escalation recommendation) is a pure text-analysis/documentation task requiring no network access, credentials, or unavailable tooling, so it is fully achievable in this offline runtime.
